scope: Static read-only comparison of both editor copies and active Hub handlers
method: Editor POST call sites were matched to hub.py dispatcher and handler bodies; no POST request was issued.

rows.mutation: selection JSONL + ledger decision; may trigger triage discard
rows.human_gate: implicit UI action; no confirmed field required
rows.risk: destructive-looking discard is reversible only through undo, but UI action itself is not confirmation-gated

rows.human_gate: status defaults human_draft; no confirmed field required
rows.risk: classification is persistent but can be written without an explicit confirmation marker

rows.human_gate: explicit UI action; no confirmation field
rows.idempotent: per-item lock; duplicate behavior requires runtime test
rows.risk: provider computation and persistent output are not visibly labeled as cost-bearing before action

rows.mutation: append-only human review in common ledger
rows.human_gate: yes: decision accept/revise/reject and ledger-backed review
rows.risk: accept is human review, but public promotion remains false by contract

rows.mutation: proxies POST to research/codex service via _ejecutar
rows.human_gate: no explicit confirmation field; editor button sends immediately
rows.risk: external service side effect is stronger than local read-only wording; needs explicit dispatch receipt and confirmation
context relation can become durable without a typed evidence state

rows.human_gate: decision is sent from UI; confirmation semantics not uniform
rows.risk: review and publication meanings should remain separate in schema

rows.human_gate: explicit provider action; result remains candidate
rows.risk: external provider call and candidate persistence need cost, provenance and retry metadata

rows.mutation: feedback JSONL, and accepted/corrected relations may connect
rows.human_gate: accept/reject action; undo requires human-confirmation internal path
rows.risk: accept feedback can create a connection as a second mutation; compound outcome needs transaction/receipt

rows.mutation: boards.json create/add/remove plus feedback on additions
rows.risk: concurrent board updates can race and board add can partially save feedback before board save
durable relation lacks explicit evidence/owner fields in this route

findings.evidence: feedback accept/correct can append feedback and create connection; board add can append feedback and then save boards.
findings.improvement: Return a transaction-like receipt with all sub-results and recovery action; use a shared lock or atomic append protocol.

findings.evidence: /api/portfolio/dispatch calls _ejecutar, which POSTs to research/codex, without a confirmed field in _portfolio_dispatch.
findings.improvement: Require explicit human confirmation or rename/label as dispatch; return target service, job id, and immutable receipt.

findings.evidence: _portfolio_save_boards uses temp+replace, but _portfolio_board_action has no board-specific lock.
findings.improvement: Serialize board read-modify-write and add conflict/version field.

findings.evidence: selection/classification/feedback have different status, ledger and confirmation semantics.
findings.improvement: Define a shared mutation envelope: actor, confirmed_at, consent, evidence, operation_id, idempotency_key, promotion=false.
